## Live replacement

**Live file swap: proven live.** lilspark Eden: apply_live / session_swap reboot the title in the same session (round lost). i9 Yuzu: hot reload proven - body arc overwritten in place at the RESULTS boundary (any valid arc length), next round in the same session read it, no restart (round 32).

**Pick whip: partial.** Identify only: the enemy's RAM class names its archive (enemy_identity) and the tactical map takes enemy clicks as bot goals (implemented, unverified live on RE6). model_swap puts the slot back to native at the next round boundary; no RE6 redraw, no screen-point pick backend.

**Live controls:** merc_live_controls re6: infinite_ammo/tablets/stamina/grenades, auto_qte(_ram), kill_time, fire_rate 1-80, magnum_speed, bomb_mind, throw_speed, quick_attack, down_fire; detonate, bomb_drop, grenade_scatter, flash_now, magnum_quick4, model_swap (RE6 slots go native).

### RAM map `profiles/gamedata/01002A000CD48000-ram.json` (01002A000CD48000, little-endian)

The map holds no absolute fields (an ASLR title: the driver resolves module base + offset); its notes:

- MT Framework, 64-bit: every manager is a singleton next to its class descriptor (MtDTI); RE6 builds its DTIs inline in the static initialisers. An object's class is the name its vtable's slot 5 (getDTI) returns.
- ASLR may move main: every address is main's base (gbox.mercs.titles.re6_switch.module_base: 64 bytes of main's read-only data at +0x2151000) plus an offset, so this map holds no absolute fields; the driver reads them.
- Measured live 2026-10-26 on the Spark (Citron NEO, NCE: a guest address is the host address) in THE MERCENARIES NO MERCY, Urban Chaos, Leon: sGameMan base+0x28E9B10 (+0x54 mode, +0x3DEC phase, +0x3DF0 seconds left, +0x408C kills, +0x4094 combo, +0x4098 max combo, +0x409C combo window, +0x40B0 score…
- The HUD agreed with sGameMan: 009/300, Score 3,890 rolling to 4,540, 002 COMBO (docs/research/re6-switch-ram.md).
- A fresh save opens the main menu only after gbox.re6_switch_unlock set the save's Prologue-cleared bit at the title (game_unlocks.session_start on launch); the menus press A at the title only when uIdTitle00 +0x20A = 1.
- Live mods (gbox.mercs.titles.re6_switch_mods, the playing_ops): infinite_ammo keeps every gun's magazine at its capacity (the inventory: 24 cItem slots at player +0x5070, 0x28 each, found by their +0x9 index: 0-6 the weapons, 7-14 the item wheel, 15-23 the start list's stacks; +0xA u16 type, +0xE c…

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- Hot reload is proven only on Yuzu/i9; on lilspark Eden it is untested, and switch_mods.hotswap pads shorter payloads, which broke the RE6 load on the i9 (round 20) - it must allow a different valid length or exact sizes.
- Textured enemy reskins: the i9 found enemy materials bind to the unit's asset list; re6_enemy_cast's class-material route is offline-verified only - needs a gameplay frame.
- No resource-manager hook or mapped MOD/texture-unit pointers on Switch: nothing can change a mesh mid-round.
- donor_swap has no RE6 redraw (native only), so 'swap this character' cannot draw the next donor.
- Screen pickwhip needs the camera FOV/projection (pos/target are mapped) plus a pick_identify backend for Switch.
- Native effects are Linux NCE only (none on the i9 Yuzu lane); large rosters (41-45 arcs) hang or crash, AcHead donors suspected.
- Which body costume 1 uses, the stage-code to stage-name table (only s1208 measured) and the greybox / enemy-pool builds are unbooted.
